lines.en: Why are you wearing your building watch vest?
Because, dummy! We're in the middle of an emergency!
This is the hottest day in Seattle in over 20 years
and we're having a power blackout!
Did you just call me a dummy?
- I got it! - Awesome!
- Guento! - Oh, yeah!
What is that item?
It is a 15 kilowatt liquid propane generator
with a 993 cc ProGuard 35 horsepower V-twin engine.
Yeah, I said all that.
- Right in here, everyone. - Uh, Mrs. Benson?
Here we go. Come along.
My children never call me.
I'm so sorry. Right in here.
- Who are these people? - The elderly.
- They all live in this building. - But why are you bringing them in here?
Every apartment is nearly 100 degrees inside.
Yours is the only one with air conditioning.
Why can't they go somewhere--
When temperatures get too high, the elderly will start to die!
Wow, that's a creepy rhyme.
